properties.project_name: Piers 38 & 40 -- proposed redevelopment (San Francisco Waterfront Partners) adjacent to Mission Rock
properties.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 9900038 and 9900040 (recorded ; mapped 1998-07-01; active), joined into one outline; cross-checked against Esri World Imagery (zoom 20, imagery captured 2025-08-29).
properties.accuracy_caveat: The outline is the union of Assessor lots 9900038 and 9900040, so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a trace. Pier 38 is lot 9900038 and Pier 40 is lot 9900040 (DataSF lists both as active, block 9900, the pier number as the lot, street name KING), and the earlier traces lie 95% inside the two lots together, so the match is clear; no Port document read names the lots. Each lot's edge can run a few metres off the visible deck edge, and includes ground the traces left out (the Pier 38 bulkhead building along the Embarcadero and aprons); the lots are the legal boundaries. Status and use are as shown on this record.
properties.why_no_real_parcel: Each pier has its own Assessor lot (Pier 38 is 9900038 and Pier 40 is 9900040; DataSF Parcels, acdm-wktn, active); this record is one project over two lots, and its outline is the two lots.
properties.regulatory_context: Developer: San Francisco Waterfront Partners III, LLC (SFWP), an affiliate of Pacific Waterfront Partners (PWP). Original Exclusive Negotiating Agreement: Port Commission Resolution 21-10 (2021-02-23), expired 2023-03-15 for missed performance dates. PWP separately owed the Port over $980,000 in back rent on three unrelated leases (Pier 28, two Agriculture Building suites), unpaid since it vacated them 2024-01-31. On 2026-04-28 the Port Commission adopted a Settlement Agreement (Resolution 26-21: PWP to pay $720,000 over 3 years, with the remainder of the debt forgiven on compliance) and an Amended and Restated ENA (Resolution 26-22: a 12-month 'Evaluation Period' to explore value engineering, project phasing and a new financial partner, with a new Schedule of Performance due before the period ends around April 2027). No lease, term sheet or CEQA review is in place as of this record's own last_verified date.
properties.notes: The outline is Assessor lots 9900038 (Pier 38) and 9900040 (Pier 40) (see the accuracy note). The 2022 scope estimate (~215,000 sq ft office, up to 20,000 sq ft retail, ~$528-536M cost) is explicitly under review ('value engineering', 'scope reduction') per the April 2026 Amended ENA and is not treated as current. Separately, an August 2026 marketing listing ('Pacific Cornerstone') offers up to ~279,876 sq ft of the piers for long-term lease to credit tenants, positioning occupancy for late 2029 -- parallel tenant-marketing activity alongside the Port's own Evaluation Period, not a confirmed deal.
